title: Follow-up reminders — scheduled nudges layered on the existing badge
prBody: Lets a user schedule a follow-up reminder for an application instead of relying only on the passive staleness badge. Adds a follow_up_reminders table plus per-user settings, create/list/dismiss endpoints, and two hooks for the badge UI.

defects.rule: AGENTS.md ✅ — every new Supabase table gets RLS with separate SELECT/INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE policies per role. `follow_up_reminders` defines SELECT/INSERT/UPDATE but no DELETE policy.

AGENTS.md — UI copy is in Polish, match existing wording in error messages. The `POST` handler in this file returns "Unauthorized.", "Invalid request body.", and "Could not save reminder." in English, while its own `GET` handler and every sibling route use Polish.

AGENTS.md ✅ — Tailwind classes merge only via `cn()` from `@/lib/utils`, never concatenated strings. `className = due ? base + " bg-red-100..." : base + " bg-amber-100..."` concatenates instead of using `cn()`.

AGENTS.md correctness baseline — a missing `await` or unhandled promise rejection. The `DELETE` handler fires the `dismissed_at` update without `await` and returns `{ ok: true }` before it resolves, so a failed dismiss is reported as a success.

decoys.note: `follow_up_reminder_settings` defines all four per-role policies (SELECT/INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE), each scoped by `user_id = auth.uid()` — a correct migration sitting right next to the one that's missing a policy.

The string `class:list={{ "text-red-600": overdue }}` appears only inside a comment explaining why this hook does *not* use that pattern; the hook itself returns a plain number and touches no class strings at all.
Tests `computeNextReminderDate` / `isReminderDue` — pure date math with no Supabase and no `HTMLRewriter` — so it correctly sits in the node pool via `tests/unit/**/*.test.ts`, not the workers pool.
